app.title: Smart greenhouse
app.subtitle: Zone monitor and environmental readings
steps.title: How to use this panel
steps.1: Create a zone (left form) or pick one from the list.
steps.2: When a zone is selected you’ll see its measurement history.
steps.3: Log temperature, humidity, light or soil moisture with the form below.

auth.deployHint: If the site and API are on different domains, add VITE_API_PREFIX in Vercel (Settings → Environment Variables) set to your public API URL ending in /api, e.g. https://your-app.up.railway.app/api then trigger a new deploy (Rebuild). If it is already set, check APP_CORS_ORIGINS on Railway includes this frontend origin exactly.
